# Trio Restaurant & Lounge (TRiO)

> Soul food restaurant, cocktail bar and lounge at 3817 Hull Street Rd, Richmond, VA 23224 (Southside Richmond). Soul food by day, lounge by night: fried and smothered pork chops, catfish, wings, turkey wings, crab cakes and classic sides, plus signature Hennessy cocktails, a full bar, a cigar room, hookah, live DJs and weekly events. Mature atmosphere in the evening; kid-friendly until 6 PM.

Website: https://triorva.com/

## Contact and booking
- Address: 3817 Hull Street Rd, Richmond, VA 23224
- Phone (reservations): (804) 298-3775
- Reservations: call (804) 298-3775. Tables and sections can also be requested by Instagram DM (@triorestaurantnloungerva).
- Delivery: DoorDash https://www.doordash.com/store/trio-restaurant-&-lounge-richmond-1803823/
- Online pickup: Toast https://order.toasttab.com/online/trio-smb-pos-3817-hull-street-road
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/triorestaurantnloungerva/
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@triorva7
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/TRIO-Restaurant-Lounge-100068865251230/

## Hours
- Tuesday: 11 AM – 9 PM
- Wednesday: 12 PM – 9 PM
- Thursday: 12 PM – 9 PM
- Friday: 12 PM – 1 AM
- Saturday: 12 PM – 1 AM
- Sunday: 12 PM – 5 PM
- Monday: Closed
- Kid-friendly until 6 PM. Some events are 21+ or 30+.

## Weekly events (lineups change; Trio posts the latest on Instagram)
- Tuesday: Lunch specials 11 AM – 2 PM; happy hour 3 – 7 PM; food and drink specials.
- Wednesday: Wings & Whiskey Wednesdays with MC Choco & DJ Drake; wing and whiskey specials; happy hour 4 – 7 PM.
- Thursday: R&B Thursdays Happy Hour with DJ Rell Miles; happy hour 4 – 7 PM; Lemon Drop Flight (3 flavors) $20, 5:30 – 8 PM.
- Friday: Friday Sessions with DJ MG, DJ K Dogg and a guest DJ; dinner and party; happy hour 4 – 8 PM.
- Saturday: Ladies Night Out with KISS 105.7, 9 PM – 1 AM; ladies free all night; food specials; 30+ event.
- Sunday (football season): Game Day day party with MC Choco & DJ Drake.
- Also: "Back to the Band" live music series (Funkmotor Entertainment) and themed parties such as the All White party with the LB&C Band live.
- Tables and sections are reservable. Bottle service is available (Patrón bottle $250). Cigars sold in-house.
- Some event nights have a cover charge or seating deposit.

## Price guide (in-house menu prices)
- Baskets with fries: $11.99 – $22.00
- Sandwiches with fries: $11.99 – $16.99
- Entrées: $17.99 – $26.99
- Seafood dinners: $17.99 – $29.99
- Trio combos: $21.99 – $25.99
- Trio platters: $31.99 – $34.99 (Seafood Platter $31.99, Ultimate Platter $33.99, TRIO Feast $34.99)
- Sides: $5.25 (potato salad $5.75, cornbread $4.50, dinner roll $1.25)
- Kids meals: $10.99 – $12.50
- Signature cocktails: $8 – $17
- Beer: domestic $5, imports $6, drafts from $3

## Menu highlights
- Guest favorites: smothered pork chops (2) $23.99, fried pork chops (2) $22.99, fried catfish (2) $22.50, wingettes (6) $18.99, turkey wings (2) $26.99, crab cakes (2) $29.99, seafood platter $31.99, mac & cheese, collard greens and candied yams ($5.25 each).
- Entrées: jumbo wings, wingettes (flats or drums available), chicken tenders, baked chicken wings, smothered chicken wings, turkey wings, meatloaf, fried or smothered pork chops.
- Seafood: whiting, tilapia (fried or grilled), catfish (fried or grilled), shrimp (fried or grilled), crab cakes.
- Sandwiches: crab cake, catfish, tilapia, whiting, pork chop, bologna burger, Angus burger, Philly cheese chicken sub, Philly cheese steak sub.
- Sides: mac & cheese, collards, string beans, candied yams, rice & gravy, fries, mashed potatoes, cabbage, potato salad, cornbread, dinner roll.
- Sauces ($2.25): sweet chili, buffalo, teriyaki, garlic parmesan, Old Bay, lemon pepper, BBQ.
- Desserts: sweet potato pie, coconut pie ($4.50 slice), cake slices $4.99 (strawberry, lemon, chocolate, banana, pound, coconut), whole pie $27.50, whole cake $35.
- Signature cocktails: Hull Street Hennessy $15, White Hennessy $17, Strawberry Hennessy $14, Call Me Later $15, Pretty Dangerous $15, Trashcan $15, A Taste of Torri $14, Nikki Ikki Fruit Punch $14, Rum Punch $14, Juicy Fruit $12, South of the James $11, Baltimore Zoo $10, Long Island $8, Margarita $8 (top shelf $14), Mango/Strawberry Margarita $8.50, Marg-Trio $14, Teremana Margarita $12, Old Fashioned $14, Mojito $8.99, Lavender Lemon Drop.
- Full bar: Hennessy, Patrón, Don Julio, Casamigos, Crown and more.

## Frequently asked questions
- Do I need a reservation? Reservations are taken by phone at (804) 298-3775 and are recommended for busy event nights; tables and sections can also be requested by Instagram DM.
- Is there parking? Yes, parking is available at the restaurant.
- Is Trio kid-friendly? Yes, until 6 PM, with a kids menu from $10.99. Evenings are for adults; some events are 21+ or 30+.
- Is there a cover charge? Some event nights have a cover or seating deposit.
- When is happy hour? Tuesday 3 – 7 PM, Wednesday and Thursday 4 – 7 PM, Friday 4 – 8 PM.
- Does Trio deliver? Yes, through DoorDash.
- Is Ladies Night free? Yes, ladies are free all night at Saturday's Ladies Night Out with KISS 105.7 (9 PM – 1 AM, 30+).
